1.note: The word for God, {r4}, is plural in form, yet its verb {r3}, "created", is singular. The English shows neither.

3.note: "Let there be" and "there was" are one verb: {r4} and {r7}. The command and its result are spelled the same, apart from the "and" attached to the second.

5.note: "Called" comes twice, in two forms. {r2} is the narrative past that moves the story on, while {r12} is a plain completed action, placed after "darkness" instead of first.

8.note: "Sky" here is {r7}, the same word shown as "heavens" in verse 1 and "air" in verses 26, 28 and 30.

9.note: "One" in "one place" is {r13}, the word used for the "first" day in verse 5. "Appear" is {r15}, the verb for "saw" elsewhere, here in a pattern that is usually passive or reflexive.

11.note: Two verb-and-noun pairs share their consonants: {r4} with {r7}, and {r9} with {r10}. In English they become "produce" and "vegetation", "yielding" and "seed", so the echo disappears.

12.note: "Bearing" fruit is {r14}, the verb shown as "made" in verses 7, 16, 25, 26 and 31. The trees make fruit with the same word.

14.note: "Let there be" is {r4}, a singular verb, although its subject {r5}, "lights", is plural.

20.note: Two verb-and-noun pairs share their consonants: {r4} "swarm" with {r7}, and {r11} "birds" with {r12} "fly". The English, "teem with living creatures" and "let birds fly", shows neither echo.

22.note: "Multiply" is one verb in two forms. {r10} is a direct command, and {r22} is a wish or command about something else: "let birds multiply".

25.note: {r5} is "animals" in the word-by-word English here. The same word is shown as "beasts" in verses 24 and 30 and "living thing" in verse 28.

26.note: "Man", {r5}, is singular in form, but its verb {r13}, "rule", is plural. At the end, the noun {r36} and the verb {r38} share their consonants: the "creeping thing" that "creeps".

27.note: "Created" appears 3 times in this one verse: {r2}, {r13} and {r19}. Its dictionary form is used 5 times in the whole chapter.

29.note: "Given" is {r5}, the verb shown as "placed" in verse 17. "Face" is {r15}, the word shown as "surface" in verse 2.

30.note: "Breath of life" is {r23} {r24}, the same two words shown as "creatures" and "living" in verses 20, 21 and 24.
